description: She wears a floor-length muted plum gown with a square neckline and a fitted bodice. Narrow gold geometric borders run across the neckline, around the elbow-length sleeve ends, at the waist and down the skirt front. Round decorative brooches sit at the shoulders. A cream underdress is visible through the lower front opening. A cream wrap with narrow matching gold and dark borders drapes around her forearms. Gold drop earrings, a small pendant necklace and simple rings complete the outfit; a brown-gold closed shoe is visible below the hem.
